**Dedupe added.** A key sent within the last 5 minutes drops the repeat. Only real sends update the clock, so a dropped flap does not extend the window.

`node simulate.js` drops 99, zero errors. That matches the flap rate in `events.js`.

The 5 minute edge is inclusive. A repeat at exactly 5 minutes drops. Say the word if you want it to pass.
